row.proto: void FeTile_Add_EraTile(void *tiles, void *alloc, uint8_t index, const char *node, const char *name, uint8_t enabled, const char *title, const char *command, const char *image, uint8_t is_dlc)
row.notes: Adds one era-select tile: allocates a 0x1a8 Tile from alloc (vtable call +0x18), constructs it with node (the VM child name, select_tile_<n>) and the template era_select_tile, sets VM name/enabled/title/subtitle(empty)/command/is_dlc, keeps name, title and command as C-string holders (command at Tile+0x150, which the press handler 0x141a6e420 raises as entrant_list_selected), binds image (#overrides.home_screen.tiles_solo_6x6[...]) and pushes {alloc, Tile*} onto the vector at tiles+0x48. tiles = view model+0x690, alloc = *(view model+0x270), index = tiles added so far. Stock F1 2025 tile: name f1, title lng_showroom_f1, command f1_2025, image tiles_solo_6x6[f1], is_dlc 0. All 11 calls are in FeTile_Build_EraTiles.

verify.notes: V1002 Re-decompiled from the f1-modding master (no KB names there) and read the disassembly. Args: rcx tiles, rdx alloc, r8b index (passed to FeTile_Construct_Tile as the priority), r9 node, then [rsp+0xf0] name, byte [rsp+0xf8] enabled, [rsp+0x100] title, [rsp+0x108] command, [rsp+0x110] image, byte [rsp+0x118] is_dlc, so the proto order and types are right. node is djb2-hashed into the child of the tiles node (*(tiles+8)), and if it contains '#', '.', '[' or ']' no child is made and the empty handle is used. It is also the name given to the Tile ctor with template era_select_tile. The 0x1a8 Tile comes from alloc vt+0x18 (align 0x10). The holders are {vt, node, next, prev}: name +0xc8, enabled +0xe8, title +0x108, subtitle +0x128 (set to an empty string), command +0x148, image +0x168, is_dlc +0x188. So Tile+0x150 is the command holder's node handle, and the press handler reads exactly that (lea rdi,[r14+0x150] at 0x141a6e70b). It pushes {alloc, Tile} onto [tiles+0x48,+0x50) with capacity +0x58, growing 1.5x through the allocator at tiles+0x40. There is no NULL check when the Tile allocation fails. A rel32 scan of .xtls and .data1 finds exactly the 11 calls, all in the builder. sigcheck: one hit
